activity_context.topic_title: Identifying the Pivot Columns of a Matrix

feedback.problem:
The row echelon form matrix $A$ is given below. What are its **non**-pivot columns?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $A$ has $2$ pivots in the $2$nd and $3$rd columns:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the only non-pivot column is the $1$st column.
